description:
HushGram v0.0.3 has 35 patches for Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 (arm64-v8a, version code 385511871), fourteen more than v0.0.2. It still runs on Android 9 and newer. Most of the new patches were asked for in #1.

**Before you sign in,** read the section of that name in the README. A re-signed Instagram can't pass Google's Play Store check whatever the patches do, so a spare account keeps your main one out of it.

## New patches

* `Hide suggested posts`. Posts and reels from accounts you don't follow come out of your home feed, along with the rows of suggested accounts and what Instagram mixes in from Threads. Each has its own switch in a new Feed section. If nobody you follow has posted lately, Home shows Instagram's own welcome card instead of a placeholder that never loads.
* `Start Home on Following`, off until you pick it. Home opens on accounts you follow, with Instagram's own picker at the top for switching to For you or Favorites. Turn on Only accounts you follow under it and For you leaves the picker.
* `Hide suggested stories`. Stories from accounts you don't follow leave the row at the top of Home. A second switch, off to start, takes the whole row away.
* `Hide Meta AI`. The search bars in the Search tab and in your messages go back to a plain search, and a search's results lose the "Ask a follow-up" bar. Home's top bar loses Meta AI's buttons, and Meta AI's videos and chats come out of your feed too.
* `Hide the Explore grid`, off until you pick it. The Search tab keeps its search bar and the grid of posts and reels under it is gone. Searching still works.
* `Keep the reel speed`. Lock a reel at 2x with Instagram's own lock and the next reels play at 2x as well. Slide the lock off, or restart Instagram, to go back to normal speed. Ads always start at normal speed.
* `Show if a profile follows you`. Someone's profile says Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside their name. piko had it first.
* `Remove the empty space at the bottom`, off until you pick it. When your phone hides its navigation bar completely, or Instagram runs in a pop-up window, the tab bar sits on the bottom edge instead of over an empty strip. MyInsta and piko had this fix first.
* `Hide the Repost button`, off until you pick it. The Repost button and its count are gone from posts and reels. Share still sends a post to someone.
* `Story ring size`, off until you pick it. The rings in the stories row can be drawn anywhere from 70% to 130% of Instagram's size.
* `Hide group buttons on the share sheet`, off until you pick it. The New group button next to the share sheet's search bar is gone, and so is the button that sends to several picked people as a group, which leaves Send separately.
* `Pure black dark mode`, off until you pick it. Dark mode's near-black gray becomes pure black. Menus and sheets keep their own grays, so nothing disappears into the background.
* `Open developer options`, off until you pick it. A long press on the Home tab opens Instagram's own developer options, where its server flags can be looked at and overridden. piko had the idea first.
* `Start on x86 devices`, from Hushfacebook. Instagram stops crashing or freezing on an x86 device that runs its arm code through Android's translator, like an x86 Chromebook or an emulator. Phones with arm chips run as before.

## Fixes and changes

* `Turn off double tap to like` has two switches under it, On posts and On reels, so you can keep double tap to like on posts and still not like a reel by accident. Asked for in #6.
* `Clean up Reels` also hides the floating bubbles of friends who liked or commented and the Liked by and Followed by line with friends' faces. Reported in #7.
* `Download any video` works on a carousel and saves the page that's on screen. Turn on Download feed photos and photo posts get a Download row too, saving the largest size Instagram has.
* `Disable analytics` now refuses Instagram's crash reports and startup pings to b-www.facebook.com and keeps usage events off its realtime stream. It also skips the "Set up on new device" screens asking for contacts and location, which would otherwise come back on every start. piko found that loop first.
* `Open links in external browser` keeps a link you follow inside an ad's page in the app, with the ad.
* `Tap to play` and `Download any reel` read Instagram's yes or no answers in a form that still loads if an update changes how they're returned.
* Resume long videos has a Clear remembered positions row that deletes the spots it keeps and cancels any restore that's waiting, even when playback is off or paused. Tap it again within 10 seconds to undo once.
* Ring size, Playback quality and Only accounts you follow say which switch turns them on while that switch is off, and keep your choice.
* The HushGram row at the top of Settings and activity wraps its title at large text sizes instead of cutting it off.
* The Before you sign in notice and the README's sign-in advice stick to what's known. They no longer rank install methods by risk. The notice is updated in all five translations.
* With Debug logging on, the diagnostic report shows how many of their code targets Disable analytics, Sanitize sharing links and Start on x86 devices found when you patched.
* View stories anonymously now says what a phone showed. A story you've watched keeps its colored ring and keeps showing as new.

## Under the hood

* The build moved to Gradle 9.8.0 and Guava 33.7.2, which fixes GHSA-xxph-c9ww-hj94. Guava only runs while the patches are built, and the bundle doesn't ship it.
* The dependency audit now checks the build's own tools apart from the shipped bundle. Netty, JDOM and jose4j in those tools moved past their affected versions.
* Eighteen more hooks are pinned in the patched-build check, and a hook that takes a boolean fails the build.
* The release receipt reads each patch's target coverage out of the patched APK, so a required target that's missing stops the release even when its patch applied.
* Every script that came over from Hushfacebook names the commit it came from.
* The release tooling's own tests no longer refuse the source commit of a release after the first one.

## Update steps

1. You need Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. If HushGram is already a source, update it there. Otherwise add it with this link: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushGram
2. Patch Instagram 449.0.0.52.84, the arm64-v8a build with version code 385511871. That's the build these patches were checked against.
3. Install over your current HushGram build with the same Manager signing key. Android keeps Instagram's data that way, so you stay signed in. A different key means uninstalling first.
4. The `.mpp` here is a patch bundle for Morphe Manager, not an Instagram APK.

## Known limitations

* `Start on x86 devices` hasn't been tried on an x86 device yet. On an arm phone Instagram starts and runs as before.
* A few parts of this release were checked in tests and against Instagram's code but never seen on a phone, because the test account doesn't get them. That covers Home's Meta AI buttons, suggested stories in the stories row, friends' activity in Reels, a profile that shows Follows you, and sending to a group from the share sheet.
* Clear remembered positions and its Undo were checked in tests and an offscreen preview, not on a phone yet.
* Tap to play leaving a reel stopped by a tappable sticker to Instagram was read from Instagram 449's code. No reel like that turned up on a phone.
* Instagram 449 ignores an Arabic app language, so HushGram's right-to-left layout was only checked with Android's forced right-to-left setting.
* `Sanitize sharing links` cleans what Copy link and Share hand out on 449. Instagram's server adds the `stkn` key, and no scan of the app shows it, so a new Instagram build needs a real shared link checked.
* The diagnostic report's target counts say what matched when you patched. They don't show that a request was stopped while the app ran.
* A re-signed Instagram can't pass Google's Play Store check, and Instagram checks the app when you sign in.

## Validation

658 runtime tests and 369 patch tests passed locally, none skipped, including the tests that read the real Instagram build. All 35 patches applied to Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 (version code 385511871) without forcing, and the patched build passed the resource table and injected-code checks. Disable analytics found all 7 of its code targets, Sanitize sharing links all 5 and Start on x86 devices both of its 2. The manifest changes only by the three advertising permissions `Remove the advertising ID` takes out. OSV has no advisory for any library the bundle carries (gson 2.14.0, kotlin-stdlib 2.4.20 and annotations 13.0).

Every file here is listed in `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and `release-receipt-0.0.3.json` says what applied to Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 and which toolchain built the bundle.

patches.name: Clean up Reels
patches.description: Hides the Follow button on reels, the pills that push Edits, templates, Meta AI and Ray-Ban Meta glasses, and friends' activity with the comment preview. Each part has its own switch.

patches.name: Default playback quality
patches.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose in HushGram's settings, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Sends Instagram's usage events and crash reports to an address on your phone that refuses them, instead of to Instagram's and Facebook's servers. It also skips the contacts and location setup screens, which would come back on every start without those events. Restart Instagram after changing the switch.

patches.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches.description: Stops telling Instagram which reels you watched and how far into them you got. It's used to rank your Reels, and nobody else sees it. Reels you've already watched may come back.

patches.name: Download any reel
patches.description: Adds Download to every reel's more menu. Reels save at the Download quality you set, best by default, without Instagram's watermark.

patches.name: Download any story
patches.description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. A video saves at the Download quality you set, a photo at its largest size.

patches.name: Download any video
patches.description: Adds Download to the menu of a post in your feed with a video, and of a carousel showing a video. Videos save at the Download quality you set, without Instagram's watermark. A second switch does the same for photo posts.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Hides sponsored posts, reels and stories. Instagram is told the ad didn't go in, so no gap is left where it would have been.

patches.name: Hide group buttons on the share sheet
patches.description: Takes the New group button away from beside the share sheet's search bar, and the button that sends to the people you picked as one group, so they get it one by one. You can still start a group from your messages.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI
patches.description: Takes Meta AI out of the search bars, in the Search tab and at the top of your messages, so they search the plain way, drops the Ask a follow-up bar under search results and Meta AI's buttons in Home's top bar, and removes Meta AI's posts from your home feed. Each has its own switch, and the search one shows once Instagram restarts.

patches.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches.description: Removes the rows of suggested reels between posts in your home feed, and the other units that open the Reels viewer from there. A reel someone you follow posts stays.

patches.name: Hide suggested posts
patches.description: Removes the posts and reels from accounts you don't follow that Instagram puts in your home feed as Suggested for you, the rows of accounts, shops and hashtags it suggests you follow, and the posts and accounts from Threads it mixes in. Each has its own switch. Posts from accounts you follow stay.

patches.name: Hide suggested stories
patches.description: Removes the stories from accounts you don't follow, and the accounts Instagram suggests, from the row of stories at the top of Home. A second switch, off to start, takes the whole row away.

patches.name: Hide the Explore grid
patches.description: Empties the grid of posts and reels under the Search tab's bar. Search, your recent searches and search results stay.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar, and a start or a notification meant for it opens Home. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open, and a change to the switch shows once Instagram restarts.

patches.name: Hide the Repost button
patches.description: Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still sends a post or reel to someone.

patches.name: HushGram settings
patches.description: Adds HushGram settings to Instagram. Long-press Instagram's launcher icon and pick HushGram settings, or tap HushGram settings at the top of Instagram's Settings and activity, to turn features on or off, pause HushGram and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.

patches.name: Keep the reel speed
patches.description: Lock a reel at 2x with Instagram's own lock (hold its edge, then slide down) and the next reels play at 2x too, until you slide the lock off, hold the edge and let go, or Instagram restarts.

patches.name: Open developer options
patches.description: A long press on the Home tab opens Instagram's own developer options, where its server flags (MetaConfig and quick experiments) can be looked at and overridden on your phone. A wrong flag can break parts of Instagram until you reset it there.

patches.name: Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens a web link you tap in your default browser instead of Instagram's in-app browser, without Instagram's click tracker. Instagram and other Meta pages, and ads, still open in the app.

patches.name: Pure black dark mode
patches.description: Instagram's dark mode uses pure black instead of its near-black gray, which looks deeper and saves power on an OLED screen. Menus, sheets and buttons keep their own grays so they stay easy to see. Chosen when you patch, with no switch.

patches.name: Remove build expired popup
patches.description: Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build doesn't update on its own, so without this it would stop working after a few weeks.

patches.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches.description: Instagram can't read your phone's advertising ID or tell Android's ad services which ads you saw or tapped. The permissions for them are taken out of the build, so Google Play services hands Instagram a string of zeros in place of the ID.

patches.name: Remove the empty space at the bottom
patches.description: Takes away the empty room Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there, on a phone that hides its navigation bar and in a pop-up window. A change to the switch shows once Instagram restarts.

patches.name: Restore trust on re-signed builds
patches.description: Lets Instagram's own signature checks pass on a re-signed build, so the parts of the app that check who signed it keep working. A Root Mount install doesn't need this patch.

patches.name: Resume long videos
patches.description: A video or reel longer than two minutes that you left partway picks up where you left it the next time it plays. Live videos and ads start as usual. Its switch starts off.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Takes stkn, igsh, utm_source and Instagram's other tracking keys off the links you copy or share, and opens a bio link without going through Instagram's click tracker. The post, reel, story or profile a link opens stays the same.

patches.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile, after their pronouns if they've set any. A switch in HushGram's settings turns it off.

patches.name: Start Home on Following
patches.description: Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow. Tap Following at the top to switch to For you, and Home remembers your pick. A second switch, off to start, takes For you out of Home. A change to either shows once Instagram restarts.

patches.name: Start on x86 devices
patches.description: Keeps Instagram from crashing or freezing on an x86 device that runs its arm code through a translator, such as an x86 Chromebook or an emulator, by skipping the one code protection step that breaks there. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before.

patches.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Turn the switch off for Instagram's timing.

patches.name: Story ring size
patches.description: Draws the rings in the stories row at the top of Home smaller, so more fit on the screen, or larger. Pick the size in HushGram's settings.

patches.name: Tap to play
patches.description: Videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves. Feed videos show a play button, the way they do when Instagram saves mobile data.

patches.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a post or a reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. A single tap still does what it did, and the Like button still likes.

patches.name: View stories anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch, because Instagram isn't told which ones you've seen. Replying or reacting still shows you, and stories you've watched keep showing as new.
